    # Calculate (k - n + 1) ^ n % MOD

    # Calculate the modular inverse of n! % MOD
    inv_factorial = pow(factorial, MOD - 2, MOD)
    
    # Final result is (result * inv_factorial) % MOD
    return (result * inv_factorial) % MOD
